commit.message:
NFC: Always quote ${srcdir} and ${pkgdir}

Just in case someone has space in his path to MINGW-packages repo.
xz: don't build docs on i686
xz: rebuild for wildcard default change

xz: re-enable docs

They are no longer enabled by default since this release

xz: Switch from upstream tarball to git tarball

That doesn't contain a configure, so run autogen.
Also needs extra build depends for things already included
in the tarball.

And remove the signing key from the bad actor.
